descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92595 AC 8; UAT TC-24 ER 4 · “"Delete & complete" removes only that patient's pending tasks”. Mixed: stated part — Delete Pending Tasks & Complete removes only that chart's pending tasks; our part — whether dictation closure and delete-and-complete log task events (Q5 / Q13, D13) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Decision D13 · S2 · Daniela

Q5 / Q6: should 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' exist (TFA-92595 AC 8 asks for it; TFA-94700 AC 5 / UAT TC-24 allow no bulk delete), and if so, should each removed task write task_deleted? Today it writes none, so tasksDeleted undercounts (OAT-06/S26)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): OAT-06/S26

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S29 Tasks that leave the list without a per-task tap: 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' and closure by dictation (events held on Q5 / Q13)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart. (UAT TC-24; UAT OAT-06 item 7; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U9 No bulk delete anywhere in the app: records are deleted one at a time, and there is no 'delete all patients' or similar control. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94699 AC 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician. Hospital chart 'QA Hosp Pending <tag>' with status note-ready and two pending tasks; the fixture Hospital patient with open tasks 'Recheck BMP in AM' and 'Order echo'; the Nursing Home resident with open tasks 'Repeat BMP Friday' and 'Weekly weight Monday'

When (a) Fixture Hospital patient, Encounter tab: type 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1.' and press Save & Extract. (b) The resident: the same text, Save & Extract. (c) 'QA Hosp Pending': Post-Round → Mark Encounter Complete → in the Pending Tasks dialog press its delete-and-complete choice ('Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' …

Then Cells: way a task leaves the list × expected event. (a)/(b): the BMP task is closed and logged as one task-completed event against its chart, if Q13 says a dictation closure counts. (c): only that chart's two pending tasks are removed (the fixture patient's 'Order echo' stays, TFA-92595 AC 8) and each removed task is logged as a task-deleted event (two rows …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94514 AC 2 + UAT TC-24 bullet 4 / OAT-06 item 7 for the events; TFA-94700 AC 5 / TFA-92579 AC 2 against TFA-92595 AC 8 for the dialog (Q5). Checkpoints (oracle.mjs) judge only the visible outcome: the removed tasks are gone and the other chart's tasks stay. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S29 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
